title: Backend capability descriptor (backend-runtime-v1)
description: Expanded backend runtime capability model for Portal feature gating. Describes what a backend host can do (methods, feature flags, UI affordances) — not what a session subject is allowed to do (see profiles.schema.json) and not connector/platform relay capabilities. Live discovery is via Brain RPC method brain.capabilities; the artifact manifest capabilities object is the install-time static claim of the same model.
$comment: Top-level is a catalog document. Validate live/static descriptors against #/$defs/capabilityDescriptor. Validate discovery frames against #/$defs/params_brain_capabilities and #/$defs/result_brain_capabilities (embedded in brain_rpc_request / brain_rpc_result envelopes from brain-rpc.schema.json).

contractMajors.description: Contract majors the descriptor claims. Align with artifact-manifest.schema.json contract and compatibility pins.

rpcMethodName.description: Dotted Brain RPC method name (e.g. vault.read, brain.capabilities).

profileName.description: Named profile seed available on this host (admin, contributor, …).

featureFlagName.description: Snake_case feature flag. v1 catalog is under x-lanyard-feature-catalog; hosts may advertise additional flags but Portal must only gate on catalogued names.

uiAffordanceName.description: Snake_case Portal UI affordance id. Catalog under x-lanyard-ui-affordance-catalog.

uiAffordanceState.description: Portal rendering state for an affordance. supported = enable controls; unsupported = hide/disable with expected empty state; degraded = show with limited function and operator-safe notice.

featureFlags.description: Boolean feature claims. Keys should prefer the v1 feature catalog. Unknown keys are allowed for forward-compat; Portal ignores names outside its allow-list.

chat.description: Relay chat sessions available on this host.

vault_write.description: Vault write path is implemented (expansion). Must be true only when vault.write is advertised on brain_rpc_methods and implements the typed params/result (lp-5q6.18). Never set true for placeholder/unimplemented hosts.

projects_delete.description: projects.delete soft-archive is implemented (expansion). Archive-only: does not purge workspace/vault disk.

models.description: Model list/select surface is implemented (models.list / models.set_active).

capabilities_discovery.description: brain.capabilities live discovery is implemented on this host.

history_read.description: history.list is implemented (expansion, lp-ye4.7). Must be true only when history.list is advertised on brain_rpc_methods.

heads_read.description: heads.artifact / heads.workspace are implemented (expansion, lp-ye4.7). Must be true only when those methods are listed on brain_rpc_methods.

uiAffordances.description: Portal UI affordance map. Prefer explicit states for every catalogued affordance so the BFF can render without guessing from method lists.

limits.description: Optional operational limits the host wants Portal to respect (may mirror Brain RPC hard caps).

descriptorSource.description: How this descriptor instance was produced. brain_rpc = live brain.capabilities result; artifact_manifest = static pin/manifest claim; combined = BFF merge of both.

capabilityDescriptor.description: Normalized backend capability claim used by Portal BFF / web state (BackendCapabilitySet).

schema_version.description: Descriptor schema major. Bump only with breaking changes to this document shape.

version.description: Backend release version when known (matches artifact manifest version).

profiles.description: Named profile seeds available on this host (v1: admin, contributor).

brain_rpc_methods.description: Brain RPC methods this host implements right now. Required v1 methods should always appear when contract.brain_rpc is 1 and the host is healthy.

ui_affordances.description: Explicit Portal UI states. When omitted, Portal may derive from features + brain_rpc_methods using x-lanyard-ui-affordance-catalog derivation rules — prefer explicit values from live discovery.

notes.description: Optional operator-safe note (e.g. partial conformance). Never include secrets.

params_brain_capabilities.description: Params for Brain RPC method brain.capabilities. Empty object is valid; future filters may be added additively.

include_limits.description: When true, host should include operational limits if known. Default true when omitted.

include_ui_affordances.description: When true, host should materialize ui_affordances explicitly. Default true when omitted.

result_brain_capabilities.description: Success result for brain.capabilities. Must set source to brain_rpc. Must include ui_affordances when the request asked for them (default true).

schema_version.description: Present when this file is treated as a sample descriptor; catalog metadata lives in x-lanyard-* extensions.

x-lanyard-separation.description: Three capability layers must not be conflated.

backend_runtime_capabilities.meaning: What the selected backend host can do (methods, features, UI affordances).

profile_capabilities.meaning: What a named backend profile grants a subject (vault_read, vault_full, chat, admin-only ops tokens).

connector_platform_capabilities.meaning: Channel and connector features (messaging transports, tool bridges). Not backend host ops.

artifact_manifest_projection.meaning: Install-time static claim: profiles, brain_rpc_methods, optional features. Subset / projection of this descriptor model.

rationale: Architecture evaluation: existing relay capability descriptors describe connector behavior, not backend runtime capabilities. Overloading relay hello would conflate layers.
Portal already routes host ops through Brain RPC (settings, vault, projects, health). Capability discovery belongs on the same authenticated egress path.
Live claims can reflect config and partial enablement after connect; artifact pins alone cannot.
Re-queryable: BFF can refresh after reconnect or version upgrade without re-running deploy.

rejected_path.name: relay_hello
rejected_path.reason: Reserved for connector/relay protocol negotiation. Backend ops capability advertising must not depend on relay hello payload shape.

static_companion.name: artifact_manifest.capabilities
static_companion.role: Install-time / pin-time claim used by deploy and offline checks. Not a substitute for live Portal gating when the host is online.
static_companion.merge_rule: When both exist, live brain.capabilities wins for UI gating; manifest remains the deploy pin authority for required methods at install.

fallback_when_method_missing: If brain.capabilities returns method_not_found, Portal BFF builds a descriptor from the compatibility pin / artifact manifest capabilities object (source=artifact_manifest).
Treat expansion features as unsupported unless the manifest features map marks them true AND methods are listed.
x-lanyard-discovery.auth: Same fail-closed L0–L3 minimum as brain.health; no vault path ACL. Any authenticated backend profile may read capabilities (not admin-only).
x-lanyard-discovery.brain_rpc_catalog_status: optional_expansion_until_implemented — not required for pure Brain RPC v1 method-set conformance (lp-k7g.6.5 required seven methods). Portal phase-4 capability modeling (lp-k7g.8.5) should prefer live discovery and fall back to manifest.

x-lanyard-feature-catalog.description: v1 feature flags used for Portal gating and manifest capabilities.features. Each flag maps to Brain RPC methods and one or more UI affordances.

chat.notes: Chat is relay-session based, not a Brain RPC method. Still a backend runtime capability.

capabilities_discovery.notes: Meta-capability: host can serve this descriptor live.

vault_write.notes: Map vault_write → vault_editor only when vault.write is implemented and listed in brain_rpc_methods. features.vault_write true with method absent is dishonest — Portal derivation treats missing method as unsupported (lp-5q6.18).

projects_delete.notes: Soft-archive only (lp-uxy.5). Result {id, archived:true}. Does not rmtree workspace. Portal confirm must state files stay on disk.

history_read.notes: lp-ye4.7. Path ACL still enforced per subject path_prefixes. Do not advertise when host has no ledger history store.

heads_read.notes: lp-ye4.7. Current-head materialization for multiplayer currentness. heads.artifact enforces path ACL; heads.workspace is workspace-scoped.

x-lanyard-ui-affordance-catalog.description: Portal UI surfaces gated by backend capabilities. Unsupported must render expected empty/disabled states (phase 4 verification) instead of crashing or calling missing methods.

chat_panel.unsupported_ui: Show chat unavailable empty state; disable send; do not open relay chat session for host ops assumptions

vault_browser.unsupported_ui: Hide vault nav entry or show Vault unavailable; never invoke vault.* RPC

vault_editor.unsupported_ui: Read-only vault: hide save/create controls; optional tooltip that host does not support vault write
vault_editor.notes: Both feature vault_write AND method vault.write are required. Do not enable vault_editor when only a placeholder or future intent exists (lp-5q6.18).

settings_page.portal_surface: Settings snapshot view (skills, models, integrations, crons read-only)
settings_page.unsupported_ui: Settings page shows Backend settings unavailable; no local Hermes-home fallback

settings_editor.unsupported_ui: Show read-only settings; disable Save; do not call settings.patch

project_picker.unsupported_ui: Empty project list with Host projects unavailable; no filesystem scrape of Hermes projects

model_selector.portal_surface: Model list and active model control in settings
model_selector.unsupported_ui: Hide model selector section or show Models not supported by this backend

cron_manager.portal_surface: Cron job list and edit UI
cron_manager.unsupported_ui: Hide cron section or show Cron not supported by this backend

host_health.unsupported_ui: Show health unknown; degrade pilot gates rather than assume ok

derivation.description: When ui_affordances is omitted (static manifest fallback), compute each affordance state:
rules: supported if every requires_features_all_of flag is true (missing flag = false) AND every requires_methods_all_of is listed in brain_rpc_methods AND (if requires_methods_any_of is non-empty) at least one of those methods is listed.
degraded is host-asserted only (e.g. brain.health status degraded while method exists); Portal must not invent degraded from method lists alone.

x-lanyard-unsupported-error-states.description: Expected outcomes when a capability is absent. UI layer must fail soft; RPC layer returns stable error codes.

portal_ui.rule: If ui_affordances.<name> is unsupported (or derived unsupported), do not mount mutating controls or issue the backing RPC. Render the affordance-specific empty/disabled copy from x-lanyard-ui-affordance-catalog.
portal_ui.http_bff: BFF capability endpoint returns the descriptor; UI routes read it before calling host ops. Prefer 200 + unsupported state over 5xx.

portal_bff_guard.rule: If a client still requests an unsupported host op, BFF may short-circuit without calling the host.

alternate.notes: Avoid 501 unless product standardizes on it; Brain RPC maps method_not_found → 404.

unimplemented_method.when: Method not in host handler table (expansion not implemented).

method_exists_profile_denied.when: Method is implemented but profile capabilities / path ACL deny the subject. This is NOT an unsupported capability — do not conflate with method_not_found.

host_down.when: Relay/host unreachable — distinct from unsupported capability.

matrix.situation: Feature flag false / method not advertised
Feature true, method advertised, profile lacks token
matrix.ui: control visible for capable roles only; others forbidden

matrix.situation: Feature true, path ACL denies vault path
matrix.ui: browser hides or greys denied paths
matrix.if_called_anyway: forbidden or not_found per path ACL policy

matrix.ui: use manifest fallback descriptor; gate expansion UI as unsupported unless manifest says otherwise
